tokens.name: ds-bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the shell; body text sits on it.

tokens.name: ds-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, inputs, menus and dialogs; text-secondary, text-muted and text sit on it.

tokens.name: ds-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav links, menu items and secondary buttons; text, text-secondary and text-muted sit on it.

tokens.name: ds-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row rules, sidebar and header dividers. Decorative; carries no meaning alone.

tokens.name: ds-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select, textarea and secondary button borders. Source value kept: 1.5:1 on surface in light and 1.9:1 in dark, below the 3:1 control-border floor; fields rely on their label and placeholder too.

tokens.name: ds-text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: ds-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and button labels on bg, surface, surface-muted and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ds-text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, table heads, empty states and placeholders on bg, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: ds-accent
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons and checkboxes. Not for text; text on it is accent-text.

tokens.name: ds-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons; accent-text sits on it.

tokens.name: ds-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, ghost buttons, the current nav item. Reads on bg, surface, surface-muted and accent-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: ds-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover colour of accent-ink text on bg, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ds-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Current nav item fill, ghost button hover and the bulk toolbar; accent-ink, accent-strong and text-secondary sit on it.

tokens.name: ds-accent-soft-border
tokens.usage: Border of the bulk toolbar. Decorative.

tokens.name: ds-accent-soft-text
tokens.usage: Selection count in the bulk toolbar on accent-soft.

tokens.name: ds-accent-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent and accent-hover (4.9:1 and 6.3:1 in dark, 6.7:1 and 8.6:1 in light).

tokens.name: ds-danger

tokens.name: ds-danger-text
tokens.usage: Text on danger.
